# Feasting at Home

> A chef-created whole food recipe blog featuring 1400+ seasonal, plant-based recipes with ad-free membership access.

Feasting at Home is Sylvia Fountaine's plant-forward cooking platform offering meticulously crafted recipes spanning vegetarian, vegan, sourdough, and international cuisines. The site combines healthy seasonal ingredients with chef expertise, supported by a membership program and curated kitchen shop.

## Key Topics

- Whole food recipes
- Plant-based cooking
- Seasonal cooking
- Vegetarian & vegan
- Chef-created recipes
- Weeknight dinners
- International cuisine
- Healthy meals
- Ad-free membership
- Subscription benefits
- Sourdough
- Salads & soups
- Pacific Northwest
- Special diets
- Kitchen tools & pantry staples

## Recipe Collection

- [All Recipes - Feasting at Home](https://www.feastingathome.com/recipes): 1400+ chef-perfected recipes including dinners, vegan, sourdough, salads, soups.
- [Feasting at Home - A food blog with healthy, whole food recipes.](https://www.feastingathome.com): Homepage for Sylvia's chef-created whole food recipe blog with seasonal, plant-based meals.

## Membership & Subscriptions

- [Ad-free Membership | Feasting At Home](https://www.feastingathome.com/membership): Membership subscription offering ad-free access to recipe collection for $49/year.

## About & Shop

- [Feasting at Home: Healthy, Seasonal, Whole Foods Recipe Blog](https://www.feastingathome.com/about): About page for Sylvia Fountaine, chef behind plant-forward seasonal whole foods blog.
- [Feasting at Home Shop | Feasting At Home](https://www.feastingathome.com/shop): Curated shop featuring kitchen tools, cookware, pantry staples, and cooking essentials.
